description: Make one of the workspace's saved recipes the default for an account, or clear it with recipe_id null. A phone edit for a post to that account is styled with it unless its series has a recipe of its own.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

recipe_id.description: A workspace recipe's id (see recipe_list with mine=true), or null to clear

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_default_set
title: Set an account's default recipe
